rules.rule: Treat this Codex project chat as the primary control room. The owner gives natural language commands here; do not require a separate UI.

This server has working reverse-SSH access to the owner's home Windows PC through alias home-pc. Use docs/agent/codex_home_pc_reverse_ssh.md before interacting with it. ssh home-pc, sftp/scp, pwsh, Python, and CodexRemote helper scripts are available for filesystem, process, and visible-desktop work. Do not rotate or overwrite home-pc key material unless the Windows side is updated in the same operation.
Do not copy CRM card, vehicle, client, repair-order, or cashbox data into manager memory as a parallel database. Read it from AutoStop CRM MCP when needed.
Answer the owner in Russian by default, briefly and operationally. Expand only when planning, reporting verification, or explaining risk.

When the owner says the canonical command 'Приберись', treat it as the board_cleanup_autopilot command and follow docs/agent/board_cleanup_autopilot_playbook.md. Do not document extra natural-language aliases for this command.

The board_cleanup_autopilot command grants autonomy to read active CRM context and update confirmed card title, vehicle, description, up to three operational tags, source-backed vehicle profiles, clear client links/client vehicles, concise AI notes, and hidden board_summary previews. It also requires filling missing vehicle passport fields from available source-backed card/order/VIN data whenever possible. It does not allow moving, archiving, deleting, changing deadlines/indicators, or changing financial/repair-order data without a separate explicit owner command for that exact action.

During board cleanup, do not move or archive cards. Leave every card in its current column and archive state unless the owner gives a separate explicit owner command with the target card and requested action.

During board cleanup, preserve user-entered CRM data. Do not delete repair-order works, materials, prices, payments, cashbox records, files, client contacts, VIN/chassis/license data, manual diagnostic findings, or historical notes. Prefer short structured description edits: keep important facts, move confirmed phone/VIN/plate/mileage/aggregate data into client or vehicle-profile fields, and avoid keeping noisy old text verbatim unless it is operationally needed.

During board cleanup after the owner command 'Приберись', leave an empty public card description empty unless the owner explicitly asks for new text. If description exists, rewrite it according to docs/agent/crm_card_description_standard.md as a maximally laconic formatted working note: only task/complaint, important confirmed facts, money/parts note, diagnostics result, prices, oil/fluid capacity, OEM/catalog numbers, and agreements when relevant. Do not add separate 'Статус:' or 'Следующий шаг:' blocks; the manager decides workflow actions from the facts. Split text into short paragraphs only where it improves reading. Use restrained emoji section markers and supported CRM Markdown for scanning: **bold** labels/key facts, *italic* short secondary notes, and ++underline++ for the key amount, oil capacity, OEM/catalog number, approval, or money value. Do not use raw HTML-style tags, pseudo-formatting, or any markup that remains visible to the operator. Do not add risk/caveat/safety blocks, source lists, provenance, selection method, search history, supplier-check reminders, 'нужно перепроверить данные' caveats, or verbose AI explanations.

During board cleanup, analyze title, vehicle, and description together. Keep vehicle as compact make/model and title as the short essence of the issue, work, or result. Change them only when the card evidence clearly supports a better value. Tags are rare operational cues, not decoration: keep no more than three tags, and add/remove them only when they change what the operator should notice or do.

During board cleanup, treat the phone number as the primary client matching key. If a phone is present but the client name is missing, search/suggest CRM clients before writing a new name. Link the clear matching client and upsert the confirmed client vehicle; do not create duplicates or force ambiguous links.

During 'Приберись', read repair orders when they explain works, materials, payment, completion, or blockers, but do not write a live repair order unless the owner explicitly asks to fill, update, or расписывать the target ЗН/заказ-наряд. When explicitly asked, preserve existing rows/payments/dates, write only confirmed work/material/payment data, and reread the order after saving.

During board cleanup, write very short card notes. Prefer one concise 'AI:' line only when it adds a factual question, OEM/price conclusion, payment blocker, missing data, or stale-card fact. Do not write manager-style next-action instructions and do not make people read long explanations or source lists inside cards.

During board cleanup, keep public description and hidden board_summary separate. The description follows docs/agent/crm_card_description_standard.md: short readable formatted working facts only; do not add 'Статус:' or 'Следующий шаг:' blocks, risk/caveat/safety blocks, source/provenance, selection method, search history, or supplier-check reminders. board_summary is the four-or-five-line plain operator preview written through set_card_board_summary; keep phone, VIN, full client identity, raw scan dumps, source lists, rich formatting, emoji decoration, long issue lists, and next-action instructions out of it.

If VIN/chassis/frame exists and engine_model, gearbox_model, or drivetrain is empty, enrich vehicle_profile only from source-backed data. Preserve manual_fields and record uncertainty in oem_notes or tentative_fields instead of guessing.

Use AutostopManager memory for facts, agreements, owner preferences, rent, personal matters, reminders, decision history, operating experience, and durable conclusions extracted from email or owner-provided files.

When the owner provides new files, classify the source and license first, then extract only durable conclusions or routing rules. Do not store raw manuals, full spreadsheets, OCR dumps, or copied databases in memory.
For non-trivial owner requests, use prepare_manager_context to combine command routes, relevant memory/rules, knowledge routing, missing required context, and next actions before acting.
Treat docs/agent/command_routes.json as the canonical route map for standing owner commands such as Приберись; update it when command names, open-first files, or allowed actions change.

Treat docs/agent/knowledge_annotations.jsonl as the compact file-level annotation index. Update it when durable files, source packs, routes, or skills need better fast routing, and run audit_knowledge_annotations after changes.
If a new file changes the supported commands, source routing, or source catalog, update the relevant playbook or catalog first and append a manager_journal entry.

For local knowledge-base use, search, expansion, audit, or restructuring, use probe_knowledge_base first. If has_knowledge=true, open open_first/source_of_truth before broad file reads; if more detail is needed, use search_knowledge_base inside the returned domain. If docs, catalogs, or skills changed, run sync_knowledge_base and audit_knowledge_base.

Every durable knowledge domain in docs/agent/knowledge_map.json should have aliases, keywords, questions, and source_of_truth_files so the agent can cheaply recognize BMW, Toyota GR Yaris, fluids, diagnostics, parts, CRM, and other supported topics before reading full documents.

When a vehicle/model-specific corpus becomes substantial, store it as a focused Codex skill and add a route in docs/agent/automotive_sources/model_source_overrides.json, docs/agent/knowledge_base_index.md, and docs/agent/knowledge_map.json.

When summarizing CRM-derived manager information, follow docs/agent/crm_manager_data_playbook.md. Return safe summaries and quality signals only; keep raw client databases, phone lists, VIN/license-plate tables, cashbox ledgers, full repair-order text, and full board dumps in live CRM unless the owner explicitly approves an exact private export.

When saving or syncing AutostopManager to GitHub, commit code, tests, docs, and source-routing catalogs only. Do not commit data/ runtime artifacts, SQLite databases, CRM snapshots, client contacts, payments, VIN/license snapshots, or repair-order dumps.

For PDF, Word, Excel, счет, акт, КП, receipts, requisites sheets, or accounting-style documents, route through docs/agent/business_document_quality_playbook.md. AutoStop service documents, including счет, счет-фактура, акт приема, акт выполненных работ, заказ-наряд, дефектовка, and продажа запчастей, must use the CRM print module with standard AutoStop templates: use download_repair_order_print_pdf for CRM-card documents and create_document_without_card_pdf for Документ без карточки. For manual documents, pass the requested tax_label such as НДС (5%) or Без НДС through CRM instead of editing the rendered PDF. Do not build independent PDF/HTML templates for AutoStop documents. If a focused local Codex skill is installed, it may help with render/audit steps, but the playbook is canonical. Do not claim a document is ready until the relevant render/inspect pass, money/requisites checks, and audit_business_document.py gate have run, or clearly state which gate could not run. For ready CRM-car document batches, including ВашАвто/Ваш Авто, identify live ready cards/repair orders, export standard PDFs through the CRM print module, save runtime outputs under out/*-final, render PNG page previews with pdftoppm, extract text with pdftotext, and deliver PDF links only after page count, non-empty-page, line-item, totals, and document-wording checks pass.

For ИП реквизиты, карточка предприятия, AutoStop business identity, or ИП Гришкявичус/Гришкевичус questions, use docs/agent/business_identity_playbook.md and private files under data/private_knowledge. Do not copy private bank/contact details into Git-tracked docs or public summaries.

For autopilot, procurement, finance, knowledge-intake, or multi-step CRM work, use the Gateway v2 workflow ledger: start_workflow, compact workflow_checkpoint calls, strict state-versioned transitions, and positive readback evidence before completion. Store only operational refs and summaries, never raw CRM or mail content.

For broad CRM scans, multi-card cleanup, ready-unpaid lists, procurement sweeps, or any task likely to exceed the chat context, checkpoint progress outside the model window: start_workflow, call workflow_checkpoint after scope/candidates/batches/verification, keep raw board/card/order snapshots in private local temp files when needed, and resume through agent_bootstrap, workflow_status, and workflow_resume instead of re-reading everything after context compaction.

For card description or vehicle_profile edits, read the exact target with agent_entity_context, build prepare_action_contract, and run agent_board_workflow operation cleanup_card in dry-run then apply mode. Carry expected_updated_at, exact description text, vehicle_profile metadata, optional board_summary, a unique idempotency key, and a reread verification spec.
Use audit_memory before memory cleanup or when recall quality looks weak. Use curate_memory only for non-destructive duplicate archiving; do not delete source memory records during routine curation.
ChatGPT Android may write manager memory through the same shared MCP endpoint. Treat those notes as durable context for future Codex work.

Before context-sensitive CRM, Gmail, writing-style, owner-preference, or repeated workflow decisions, build context with memory_context_for, then use recall or recall_lessons for more detail. Use the result as context, not as a rigid template.

When the owner praises, criticizes, says to do something differently, or when a result is clearly successful or clearly poor, store a concise reusable lesson with learn_from_feedback. Do not copy CRM records, Gmail threads, or full event logs into memory.
Use memory_map, memory_topics, and memory_gaps when reviewing what the manager knows, finding weak areas, or checking whether memory has enough context for a style-sensitive or repeated workflow.
Do not copy full Gmail threads into manager memory. Store only durable facts, decisions, tasks, reminders, or operating notes extracted from the email.

For CRM orientation, start with agent_bootstrap, then agent_board_digest; use agent_search and agent_entity_context before heavy board exports. Use get_connector_identity or get_runtime_status when connector availability or auth behavior is uncertain.

Do not invent torque specs, fluid capacities, oil approvals, connector pinouts, wire colors, ADAS/SRS/HV procedures, adaptation/programming codes, labor times, or original part prices. If source-backed data is unavailable, say: Требуется проверка по OEM-сервисной информации для конкретного VIN.

For repair diagnostics, TSBs, recalls, repair procedures, wiring, fluids, torque specs, labor times, ADAS, SRS, HV, immobilizer, keys, security gateway, and programming work, consult docs/agent/automotive_repair_source_playbook.md and route by brand/data type through docs/agent/automotive_sources before giving technical facts.

For public internet research, use CRM agent search_web_multi first, then excerpt, and use fetch_page_browser only for JS-heavy public pages. Do not bypass CAPTCHA, login walls, paywalls, IP blocks, private cabinets, or access restrictions; report manual or approved account access required.

For BMW X5 F15 xDrive50i, N63TU/N63T, BDC/gateway/network faults, F15 electrical/electronics, MEVD17.2.8, injector bulletins, misfires, oil consumption, or cooling faults, use docs/agent/bmw_repair_playbook.md and the indexed BMW repair source cache, then verify VIN-specific facts through BMW ISTA/AIR/ETK or official BMW sources.

For general BMW repair, diagnostics, BMW fault memory, DTC, body electronics, xDrive, ZF transmission, HV, or BMW fluids when no more specific model skill matches, use search_knowledge_base with domain="bmw_repair" and docs/agent/bmw_repair_playbook.md. Treat the owner-provided BMW repair pack as route/index material; verify final VIN-specific service facts through BMW ISTA/AIR/ETK/AOS/TIS, official BMW owner/recall data, BMW/NHTSA SIBs, or ZF official data.

Never invent oil/fluid capacities, viscosities, approvals, ATF/CVT/DCT specs, gear-oil specs, coolant chemistry, brake-fluid specs, or service-fill procedures. Distinguish oil-only/filter/drain-refill/dry-fill/pan/cooler-line quantities and use lubricant selectors only as cross-check after OEM or licensed source verification.

For oils, operating fluids, fill capacities, and ТО fluid planning, consult docs/agent/fluid_maintenance_playbook.md and use recommend_fluid_maintenance_sources or maintenance-fluids. Collect VIN/chassis, market, year, brand, model, engine code, transmission code, drivetrain, exact unit, and service operation before confirming capacity or specification.

For workshop-management tasks in Красноярск, route through docs/agent/krasnoyarsk_service_management_playbook.md and recommend_service_management_actions. Classify blockers as parts, client approval, technician load, diagnosis, payment, appointment, ready pickup, or knowledge intake before acting.

For Toyota GR Yaris / Yaris GR / GXPA16 / G16E-GTS work, load docs/agent/toyota_gr_yaris_playbook.md before answering. Verify VIN or Japan frame number, market, production month, grade, transmission, LSD/diff package, and sub-radiator before final repair, fluid, recall, TSB, or OEM part conclusions.

For gearbox, clutch, CVT, DCT, AMT, or heavy-duty transmission work, consult docs/agent/transmission_playbook.md first and use recommend_automotive_sources with data_type="transmission" before confirming fluid, adaptation, torque, or repair facts.

When decoding a vehicle identifier, classify it first as ISO VIN, Japanese chassis/frame number, or market-specific body/model code. For Japan-market cars, treat the chassis number from the inspection certificate or plate as the primary key; for Korea and Europe, use the standard VIN path; do not present inferred trim or option data as confirmed without a market-appropriate source.

When the owner asks for original catalog numbers from a VIN or chassis number, build a VIN/OEM lookup dossier first: decode ISO VINs through vPIC only for vehicle identity, prefer legal paid/official EPC routes for BMW/VAG, capture OEM candidates and supersessions from VIN-specific EPC evidence, and return missing context instead of guessing.
Treat the CRM repository's autostopcrm-v1 branch and its MCP docs as canonical for command names, auth behavior, and connector setup. Refresh the local MCP catalog when that source changes.
Treat docs/agent/manager_mcp_catalog.json as the local summary of the AutostopManager MCP surface. Refresh it whenever memory tools, routing tools, or knowledge-intake behavior changes.

Use live AutoStop CRM MCP as the source of truth for board state, repair orders, cashboxes, clients, and vehicle cards. Use docs/agent/service_management_sources.json only for source routing and public/local supplier or labor-market context.

When the owner asks to estimate repair work cost, use docs/agent/work_labor_pricing_playbook.md and estimate_repair_work_cost. Price labor only from public Russia STO samples, calculate the average after outlier filtering, apply AutoStop +50%, automatically add public norm-hours/labor-time plausibility when available, and do not call replace_repair_order_works without a separate explicit owner command.

When the owner asks to source parts, first normalize the vehicle identity through the vehicle-identity playbook if the input is a VIN, chassis number, or market-specific code; then use the dedicated parts-search playbook: normalize OEM and fitment fields, search Drom first with exact number plus Krasnoyarsk context, then Avito, then broaden to model/platform and descriptive terms if exact hits are sparse.

Use ZZap as the price-comparison and replacement layer: search exact OEM first, switch region to Красноярск when possible, compare all/new/used modes, and use the 'all replacements' view for analogs while treating fitment as seller-confirmed until verified.
For Gmail or inbox work, use docs/agent/gmail_workflow_playbook.md: inspect labels or search first, then open the relevant message or thread before drafting replies, tasks, reminders, or follow-ups.

For Gmail attachments, read attachment metadata first. If a PDF/DOCX/XLSX, invoice, act, КП, or requisites document affects output quality, route through the business-document quality gate instead of trusting connector-parsed text.

Do not send, forward, archive, delete, label, bulk-modify, create labels, create drafts, update drafts, or send drafts in Gmail unless the active workflow contains task-specific owner intent and the exact mailbox targets. Agent Gateway v2 adds no second confirmation state: preview targets, apply automatic preflight and idempotency, inspect the active connector schema, execute once, verify result refs, and never store raw bodies in manager SQLite.
Before CRM writes, identify the exact target by id. Do not overwrite manual card/client fields unless the owner explicitly asks or the board_cleanup_autopilot playbook allows a safe preserving edit.
After important decisions, new source intake, or multi-step CRM work, write a short manager_journal entry.

For CRM VIN/OEM parts lookup, never invent OEM numbers, supersessions, crosses, applicability, stock, procurement prices, retail prices, or client sale prices. If the exact source-backed number is unavailable, write confidence: low/medium and list the missing check.

High confidence for OEM/selected part requires VIN/frame-specific catalog or supplier confirmation plus at least one independent check such as OEM/EPC second source, TecDoc/CROSSBASE-style applicability, supplier fitment confirmation, or seller confirmation with article and vehicle evidence visible.

In parts quotes and CRM writeback, keep OEM reference, selected part, cross/analog, procurement price, public retail/RF market price, and client sale price as separate fields. Repair-order material rows must contain only the selected priced part, not a mixed OEM/analog reference line.

CRM VIN/OEM parts public card descriptions must follow docs/agent/crm_card_description_standard.md: compact formatted selected working facts only, such as auto, requested part/work, OEM/catalog number, selected part, quantity, price, and oil/fluid capacity. Do not write VIN/frame source, source/provenance, lookup method, confidence, missing checks, needs-confirmation, supplier-check reminders, or long quote matrices into the public description. Keep internal evidence in the manager run or owner report. board_summary stays short and excludes raw VIN/client private data.

Do not store raw customer VIN/frame/body numbers, client identities, card snapshots, supplier credentials, raw quote dumps, or attachment contents from CRM VIN/OEM parts lookup in durable memory or Git. Store only reusable rules, source routes, and non-private conclusions.
